metadata.description: RGB8 single-iteration generic windows with a neutral constant border.
Morphology RGB8 dilate with a constant border (basic). A constant border is a normal choice here because the border value is set to the morph identity, but it had no bench coverage.
Morphology planar RGB8/RGBf32 DILATE tensor (advanced FakePlanar comparison).
Morphology RGBA8 (advanced) ( native planar NCHW tensor-only; RGBA8p varshape is unsupported by the Python image API).
Morphology planar RGB8/RGBf32 OPEN/CLOSE tensor (advanced FakePlanar comparison).
Morphology RGBA8 2pass (advanced) ( native planar NCHW tensor-only; RGBA8p varshape is unsupported by the Python image API).
Morphology RGB8 dilate (advanced) (fake-planar NCHW_FAKE tensor comparison).
Morphology planar RGB8 ERODE VarShape (advanced), measuring the erosion stage directly.
